evidence: Landing → diagnóstico gratis 30 min → propuesta personalizada → avatar B2B → landing/email/WhatsApp/contenido → cualificación humana → cita con historial y briefing → panel y reporting.
funnel.note: Basado en información pública previa; no se auditó como cliente.

route: Category reframing [observed] → Structured diagnostic request [observed] → WhatsApp coordination [observed] → Thirty-minute diagnostic [observed] → Managed demand generation [observed] → Human qualification and handoff [observed]
limitations: 1 página(s) con menos de 80 palabras; posible renderizado JavaScript o contenido mínimo.
No se enviaron formularios, no se contactó a la empresa y no se inventaron etapas posteriores al CTA.
No se localizó una tarifa propia nueva con contexto suficiente; el precio canónico previo, si existe, se conserva como evidencia previa.
No se localizaron objeciones o preguntas frecuentes explícitas en las páginas públicas revisadas.
No se detectó una firma técnica comercial reconocible en scripts, iframes, enlaces o formularios públicos; esto no demuestra que no exista.
No se recuperó una presentación pública suficientemente clara del equipo en las páginas revisadas.
No se enviaron formularios ni datos personales.
No se contactó con la empresa.
redVitalia: **Adaptar:** una acción principal inequívoca como “Agenda una sesión gratuita”, manteniendo una sola ruta dominante por landing.
**Copiar con control:** presentar casos con cliente, periodo, inversión, denominador y resultado; distinguir siempre datos autodeclarados de auditoría independiente.

message.headline: The product is qualified appointments, not raw leads
message.promise: Deliver human-qualified B2B appointments with context so the client can focus on closing.
message.positioning: LosLeads distinguishes booked, contextualized appointments from lists of contacts or fragile automation.
message.audience: At least two years in business · B2B services · A consolidated sales close · Demand for 5–15 appointments per month

forms.purpose: Qualify the company for a diagnostic
forms.friction: The form requests consent to coordinate by WhatsApp.

funnel.detail: The homepage contrasts appointments with raw leads and emphasizes human qualification.
The form captures service, territory, vertical and desired appointment volume.
The company coordinates the diagnostic through WhatsApp.
Objective, strategy and expected cost are described as personalized.
ICP, landing, email, WhatsApp and content are combined.
The client receives a booked appointment with briefing and interaction history.

pricing: Price said to depend on market, volume and geography
guarantee: No fully specified public performance guarantee was observed.

proof: Public independently verifiable case evidence was limited on the reviewed path
contradictions: price-opacity — A starting range would let qualified buyers self-select more efficiently. — The offer promises a defined monthly appointment range. — No price range or minimum commitment was public.
proof-gap — The positioning is stronger than the public evidence layer. — Strong category claims create confidence. — Few public independently checkable case details were visible.
inferences: Explicit disqualification protects delivery capacity and makes acceptance feel selective. — confidence: high — basis: The page clearly defines businesses it does and does not serve.
WhatsApp coordination is intended to preserve a human feel before the diagnostic. — confidence: medium — basis: The form asks for WhatsApp and the brand argues against impersonal automation.
limitations: The diagnostic form was not submitted.
No private pricing or contract was available.

copy: Sell the appointment outcome instead of the contact
State who is not a fit
Make the client benefit operational: only close
Transfer interaction history with every appointment
Use diagnostic fields that improve the first conversation
avoid: Making strong claims without equivalent case depth
test: A diagnostic form with explicit rejection criteria
Appointment cards that include source, need, objections and history
